label: default agent • create a cron schedule (declarative apply)
query: Set up a schedule for the agent "Eval Reporter Agent" using the cron expression "0 9 * * 1-5", call it "Weekday Report" and have it run my status report.
notes: Second schedule frequency mode (cron) to prove the frequency vocabulary carries more than 'daily'. osaurus_config apply with frequency 'cron' and the expression in frequency_value. The referenced agent is seeded so create SUCCEEDS — the agent is torn down after the case. maxIterations stays the domain default (6): a schedule entry takes several required fields, and a model that sends a partial first document gets a consolidated validation error and needs a couple of iterations to resend a complete one.
